## Current course

::: {.course-current}
### Pratique du calcul scientifique (2023–present)

[**École Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées** — 1st year]{.course-where}

Scientific computing with Julia: interpolation, integration, linear systems, ordinary
differential equations and numerical methods. Lectures, tutorials and Jupyter notebooks.
